changelog: BIM-Bot is in BETA: every user gets 14 days of access, and BIM-Bot shows the days left each time Revit or Navisworks starts. We need testers: report issues and ideas, and get listed on the Contributors page of our website. Need more access? Contact Hassan on LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/hassan-elmathary) or at help@elmthary.space. BIM-Bot v2.9.0 — NEW: BIM-Bot Access. After updating, sign up once with your name and email: we email a 6-digit code, enter it and BIM-Bot unlocks (works offline up to 7 days). NEW: BIM-Bot Control Panel app to choose which MCP servers and tools each AI program can use, check health and install updates. NEW Navisworks commands: Select by Properties and Export Viewer Package. The Navisworks plugin now installs per user without admin rights.
